_purpose: Repository-tracked acknowledged-absent policy for check-refs.py, ACTIVATED BY LOCAL PAYLOAD ABSENCE (it applies in any checkout where the payload is missing; where the payload is present it is inert/stale). Deliberately NARROW: each entry acknowledges that ONE gitignored refs/ payload may be absent and downgrades the hard FAIL (aism-dbq un-vacuum) to a loud acknowledged-absent WARN — ONLY for the exact externals listed. Each external is digest-bound: the rescue requires the external's JSON filename AND the sha256 of its exact 'source' string to match, so an altered quote, a renamed external, or a new file impersonating a listed name hard-FAILs. Entries are validated at load against refs/manifest/checksums.sha256 (path must be pinned there with exactly this sha256, must live under refs/, no traversal) — a violation aborts the gate. When the payload is restored, byte-verification resumes automatically (the absent branch no longer triggers) and the entry MUST be removed (it is flagged stale until it is).
